Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast arcane spells from the Illusionist list per the Spells Per Day table, plus bonus slots from high Intelligence.
  • Shadowcraft: when you cast Shadow Magic, you may also copy any Evocation or Conjuration spell from the Wizard list of a level you can cast, whether or not you have seen it cast.

Glamour

  • Effect: A pool of Glamour points equal to your Intelligence modifier + half your Illusionist level (minimum 1), spent on tricks: any feature that costs Glamour.
  • You regain them all on a long rest.
  • Your two starting tricks are Misdirect and Phantom Wound, below.
  • You may use one trick on your turn, and Misdirect once a round out of turn.
  • Your illusions are your Illusion spells, your Phantasm and the doubles your tricks make.
  • A creature that sees through illusions (True Seeing, truesight) ignores your doubles and Phantasm.
  • 9th level: when an encounter begins and your pool is empty, you regain 2 points.
  • Misdirect: once a round, out of turn, when a creature you can see hits you, spend 1 Glamour: it makes a Will save against your Class Save DC. On a failure the attack hits an illusory double and misses; the double lasts until the start of your next turn. You cannot use Misdirect against an attack that a spell's image has already drawn off.
    • 5th level: you may also use Misdirect when a creature you can see attacks an ally within 30ft of you.
  • Phantom Wound: as your action, spend 1 Glamour: one creature within 60ft that can see makes a Will save against your Class Save DC or takes 2d6 psychic damage. A creature that can see one of your illusions within 30ft of it, and has not seen through it, saves with Disadvantage.
    • Damage: 3d6 at 5th, 4d6 at 9th, 5d6 at 13th, 6d6 at 17th

Eye for the False

  • Effect: Advantage on saves against illusions and on checks to see through disguises. Once a round, when you interact with an illusion or suspect one, you may make the save to disbelieve it as no action.
  • 6th level: you sense the location and movement of Invisible creatures and objects within 30ft, with no check.
  • 15th level: you also sense their shape and size.
  • 20th level: you permanently see all things as the True Seeing spell.
  • Disguise (Charisma): as the Assassin's Disguise, and you may roll Intelligence instead of Charisma when the disguise is made with illusion.
    • 10th level: change your appearance at will, as the Change Self spell. Once per day the change also fools touch, smell and True Seeing until you end it

Phantasm

  • Effect: During a rest, weave an illusory companion of Small size or smaller, in any shape.
  • It lasts until destroyed or rewoven, acts on your turn at no cost, moves 30ft and cannot attack or move objects.
  • It has your AC and counts as your ally for flanking.
  • One hit or damaging effect destroys it.
  • A creature that touches it makes a Will save against your Class Save DC to see through it, and a creature that sees through it ignores it.
  • Re-form it beside you, as part of your action, for 1 Glamour.
  • 5th level: it may be your size, flies if winged, and as part of your action you see and hear through it within 120ft.
  • 15th level: only a second hit destroys it.

2nd Level

Lingering Illusion

  • Effect: Once on each of your turns, as part of your action, you may reshape one of your illusions that is still running into anything else its spell could have made. An illusion you maintain by concentration lasts 1 more round after you stop concentrating or are interrupted.
  • 8th level: your Illusion spells that need no concentration last twice as long.

3rd Level

Convincing Illusions

  • Effect: A creature makes its first save to see through each of your illusions with Disadvantage. This is the save for touching, studying or being harmed by an illusion, not a save a spell calls for with "Will negates". Always on.
  • 5th level: a creature that only studies your illusion gets no save unless something gives it clear reason to doubt (GM's call).

Mirage Step

  • Effect: As part of your movement, spend 1 Glamour: swap places with one of your illusions within 30ft.

4th Level

Quickened Illusion

  • Effect: When you cast a spell, spend Glamour equal to the level of an Illusion-school spell you have prepared, of 2nd level or lower, to cast it as part of the same action; it uses its slot as normal.
  • 9th level: 3rd level or lower.
  • 15th level: 4th level or lower.

Drawn Veil

  • Effect: As part of your action, spend 1 Glamour: after your action is resolved, you or one ally within 30ft is Invisible until the end of its next turn.

7th Level

Veiled Camp

  • Effect: When the party rests, you veil the camp as part of the rest: from more than 30ft away it looks, sounds and smells like the ground around it. A creature that comes within 30ft makes a Will save against your Class Save DC to notice it.

Seed of Doubt

  • Effect: As part of your action, spend 1 Glamour: one creature within 60ft makes a Will save against your Class Save DC.
  • On a failure, until the end of its next turn it takes one real creature or object you choose for an illusion: it will not attack or avoid it, and that creature has Advantage on attacks against it.
  • If it would take damage from what it ignores, the effect ends after that damage.

10th Level

Shattered Glass

  • Effect: As your action, spend 2 Glamour to shatter one of your illusions within 60ft. Each creature of your choice within 10ft of it makes a Will save against your Class Save DC: on a failure it takes your Phantom Wound damage and is Blinded until the end of its next turn; on a success it takes half. The illusion ends.

Renown: Name

  • Effect: Your deeds are known. Title: Master of Masks. Theatres, fairs and patrons of the arts pay you to perform (earn as a skilled trade), and you have Advantage on Reaction Checks with nobles and performers. Your first follower, a stagehand, joins you.

13th Level

Phantom Errand

  • Effect: Your Phantasm can leave you on an errand of up to a day, travelling up to 30 miles. It carries a message in your voice, watches and listens, and comes back to tell you what it saw. One hit still destroys it.

15th Level

Half-Real

  • Effect: Damage your Illusion spells deal to a creature that believes them is real: it can drop the creature to 0 HP, and Shadow Monsters, which reduces its damage to believers, deals full damage. A creature that sees through the illusion takes none.
  • Intelligence Bonus: permanent +1 Intelligence. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).
  • Renown: Holding: you may found a small playhouse as your Holding (see Your Holding (15th) in Keeps & Kingdoms).
  • Quickened Illusion, Phantasm and Eye for the False improve, as their entries say.

17th Level

Veiled Hall

  • Effect: Your Holding, or a building you stay in for a week, is veiled as your camp is for as long as you live there, and it is hidden from scrying.

20th Level

Magnum Opus

  • Effect: Once per month, in a day-long ritual, you weave your greatest illusions into one work: a single nonmagical object, a being of Level up to half yours with all its powers, or an area of 10ft×10ft per level.
  • The being is friendly to you and follows your direction; the GM plays anything against its nature.
  • The work lasts until dispelled, and cannot be dispelled for 1 day per level except by a caster of your level or higher.
  • Only one can exist at a time.
  • Each work has a 1% chance per level of becoming permanently real: it can never be dispelled or disbelieved, and no longer counts as your one Magnum Opus.

Renown: Theatre of Mirrors

  • Effect: You may found a theatre of mirrors (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 apprentices and a troupe of players join it. While you hold it, you may perform your Magnum Opus there once more each month.

Kits: Arneyan Illusion Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Illusionist folder. Drag one onto your character.

Illusionist Kits represent the tradition, school, or circumstance that trained the character in the arcane arts of illusion.

  • Each kit reshapes one of your 1st-level features, as its Reshapes line says, and improves at 9th level.
  • The peoples, orders and places a kit names are examples, not the only ones: a kit suits anyone from a tradition like it.

Illusionist Spell List

Spells available to the Illusionist, by level. * = reversible spell. ‡ = needs a costed material component (see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue). Full descriptions, saves and components are in Spellcasting in Arneyan.

  • Bonus Spells: Intelligence 13–15 grants an extra 1st level spell, 16–17 an extra 2nd level spell, 18+ an extra 3rd level spell. Cumulative, and only acquired once the Illusionist is high enough level to cast that tier.
